# Northmark Chimney
> Chimney cleaning, inspection, repair and maintenance for homeowners in Toronto and the GTA. Phone (416) 505-6228. Every Day 8:00–20:00. The inspection visit is free, at the customer's home, with the price given on the spot.

## Facts
- Phone: (416) 505-6228
- Email: Northmarkchimney@gmail.com
- Hours: Every Day 8:00–20:00
- Service area: Toronto, York, East York, North York, Scarborough, Etobicoke, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Concord, Thornhill, Richmond Hill, Markham
- The inspection visit is free and takes place at the customer's home; the exact price is given on the spot before any work begins.
- 3+ years in business: Working across Toronto and the GTA.
- 2,000+ chimneys serviced: Swept, inspected, repaired and rebuilt.
- 7 days a week: Open every day, 8:00–20:00.
- $0 for the inspection: We look first. You get the price on the spot.
- Current offer: Chimney Sweep $200, free inspection included.
